items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: great in the sound of Bean

ctx.x: Right, and great in the sound of Bean, and great in the sound of all the people he's standing for, if he puts himself out there without any clothing, which is what he's doing, I would be very proud of him and I'd be the first to congratulate him. But if he only stops at some point in history and can only emulate that, can only do that, I'm sorry, I have no favor for him.
He obviously has capabilities to do other things.
